2. Formal Semantics: RDFS, OWL Rules & SHACL Gates
fam:Grandmother rdfs:subClassOf fam:Parent . fam:hasChild rdfs:range fam:Person .
Automatic Inference: Every child and parent automatically gains type fam:Person
Typo Protection: Prevents LLM hallucinations from making a Company a Parent
Catches Malformed Data: Flags ambiguous dates (e.g. "03/04/31") before agent execution
3. NVIDIA Auto Ontology: Extraction & Semantic Compilation
GOVERNANCE REALITY: THE FOUR DATA AGENT SLOTS
NVIDIA auto-extracts terms from schema, but semantic truth requires review
Human verification flag; runtime retriever passes both unless scoped
Leaderboards score whole agent; isolated ontology delta is unpublished
Enforce DB-level read-only role; AST inspection alone is not an OS boundary
Production Takeaway: An auto-drafted ontology accelerates semantic layering,
but enterprise deterministic reliability demands human certification and strict DB roles.

5. Comparative Architectural Taxonomy: The Three Enterprise Ontology Paradigms
• Identity: Global IRIs/URIs across federated domains
• Schema: RDFS taxonomies + OWL logical axioms
• Query Interface: SPARQL declarative graph queries
Best for global data federation, biomedical graphs,
and formal academic / enterprise knowledge bases.
• Abstraction: Terms, SQL Attributes, Semantic FKs
• Discovery: Multi-pass metadata and PII probing
• Text-to-SQL: ReAct loop drafts dialect-tuned SQL
• Safety: sqlglot AST parsing bans data writes
Best for open-source AI agents exploring complex
• Objects (Nouns): Typed entities with primary keys
• Security: Row/cell-level ACLs propagated to AI
• Bounded Autonomy: Agents invoke Actions, not SQL
• Tool Calling: Pre-certified business logic functions
Best for closed-loop operational workflows where
agents must both read state and trigger ERP writes.
